sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a post-trained vision-language model with 9B parameters, 32 layers, and a Gated DeltaNet plus Gated Attention hybrid layout, built for multimodal instruction-following and tool calling, with 262,144 native context length and stated extensibility up to about 1,010,000 tokens.
